caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a woman standing on a rectangular base. The figure is shown in profile, facing left, with her hands clasped together in front of her chest in a gesture of prayer. She wears a long garment with a red inner layer and a largely black outer cloak covering her head and body. Portions of the garment are worn, revealing areas of faded red, beige, and greenish hues, indicating possible age or distress. The statue's face and hands are a light brown color, and her hair is covered by the black cloak. The background is plain and off-white, creating contrast with the statue. The base of the statue is brown with visible wood grain and angular edges. In the bottom right corner, the artist’s name and the year “1905” are inscribed: “HAZEL G. CLARLIN - 1905.”
title: Niche of  Saint Dolores
